docs(guidance): the plan loads the skill lernapps-listing when the listing starts

## Intent

The assistant should load the listing skill at the point in the last phase where it starts listing the published app, not only when it opens the listing pull request.

## Key changes

- A task "Load the skill lernapps-listing" follows right after the published app is confirmed.
- The task that opens the pull request only refers to the skill and names the end; the mention moved and no step of the skill is repeated.

moved.why: The time cut held two unrelated requests: the hooks fix and the guidance; this commit serves the second.
